## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. Distinguish native/host tests,
firmware cross-builds and actual hardware measurements where applicable.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I have the rights to submit these changes under the repository's license.
- [ ] I preserved applicable attribution and third-party notices.
- [ ] I included no credentials, purchased asset packs, vendor binaries or private-edition code.
- [ ] I described any remaining limitations or untested hardware behavior.

Maintainer review and acceptance by @EmbeddedTony are required before merging.
